overrides.rule: a loaded transition whose reaction (reactant and product components, whole species) is isomorphic to a depository reaction RMG rates from that depository carries RMG's own production rate for it: w = ssa k / T over the T loaded transitions of its channel; the reverse of a loaded pair is derived from the forward through the stored Kc form (w_r = w_f (T_f / T_r) / (ssa_ratio Kc)); every other transition keeps its template weight
